settings.title: Settings
settings.list.browser: A machine's own settings are on the desktop, where the machine is.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.theme.hint: System follows the computer's own light or dark setting.
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.hint: The window's own words, and Daoris's lines on a session's record. What agents, people and the service write is shown as written.
settings.plugins.title: Installed plugins
settings.plugins.why: What each plugin installed here holds set: whether it is on, and each server's approval for Ask Daoris with the writes accepted. A plugin's settings are changed on its own page; Open leads there.
settings.plugins.holdsNone: Holds nothing set but whether it is on.
settings.plugins.server.changed: changed since you approved it: asks again
settings.home.label: Daoris home
settings.notify.body: Nobody should have to watch a driver. This machine can tell you as it happens: a session stops to ask you something, holds a tool call for your answer, answers your words, or ends without you asking; a quest parks on its failed sessions; a start waits for an account. Never for an ending you caused, because a notice about what you just pressed is one you learn to dismiss unread.
settings.notify.label: Announce what needs you or ended
settings.notify.terminal: Also `daoris settings notify on|off` — one file, either door; a machine with no screen says it on its console.
settings.notify.state.on: On: a park, a held tool call, an answer to your words and an ending you did not ask for are each said, in the window you are at or by a system notification while Daoris is behind.
settings.notify.state.off: Off: none of these is said, and Notifications still lists each one.
settings.notify.press: A terminal's press for your confirmation is said either way: its terminal waits on your answer.
settings.notify.on: This machine will announce what needs you or ended.
settings.notify.off: This machine will announce only a terminal's press for your confirmation. Notifications still lists everything.
settings.cap.label: Sessions at once on this machine
settings.cap.terminal: Also `daoris settings cap <n>` — one file, either door.
settings.cap.body: How many sessions Daoris starts at once on this machine, across every repository. It counts the sessions Daoris starts, never a conversation you hold yourself. Raise it when too few sessions are working; lower it to spend less at a time.
settings.cap.set: Daoris now starts at most {{count}} session at once on this machine.
settings.cap.set_other: Daoris now starts at most {{count}} sessions at once on this machine.
settings.cooloff.label: Cool-off when no time is named
settings.cooloff.terminal: Also `daoris settings cooloff <minutes>` — one file, either door.
settings.cooloff.body: When an agent refuses a turn for its account's limit and names no time it resets, the account cools this many minutes before Daoris starts on it again. Long enough that a spent account is not started on at every look; short enough that a wrong guess costs an hour, not an evening. A limit that names its reset cools until then.
settings.cooloff.set: An account whose agent names no reset now cools {{count}} minute.
settings.cooloff.set_other: An account whose agent names no reset now cools {{count}} minutes.
settings.quiet.label: Look in on a quiet session after
settings.quiet.terminal: Also `daoris settings quiet <minutes>`, from 5 to 120 — one file, either door.
settings.quiet.body: A session is never stopped for running long. One that says nothing and runs nothing for this long gets Daoris's help: a word, then your choice or a fresh start of the same work.
settings.quiet.set: Daoris now looks in on a session quiet for {{count}} minute.
settings.quiet.set_other: Daoris now looks in on a session quiet for {{count}} minutes.
